semiconductor_relevance: High — Gain-Tek Semiconductor Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of essential materials for semiconductor packaging and testing, making it a key player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Gain-Tek Semiconductor Material Co., Ltd. focuses on the agency and manufacturing of critical materials for semiconductor packaging and testing, including IC packaging carrier boards and test wafers. They also provide advanced measurement solutions through exclusive partnerships, enhancing precision in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Manufacturing of IC packaging carrier boards
Production of test wafers and wafer frames
Precision measurement solutions with 3D optical profilometers

regional_presence.Taiwan: Gain-Tek has signed an exclusive general agency agreement in Taiwan to better serve the semiconductor market.
